appearance_facts.location: Pie chart center at roughly (1150, 940), radius about 780 pixels.
appearance_facts.fact: Four slices radiate from the center: a pale-yellow slice in the upper-left, an orange slice in the upper-right, a red slice in the lower-left, and a reddish-orange slice in the lower-right.
The slice spans from the top vertical edge to the upper-left diagonal edge and is labeled 'Samsung (55%)'.
The slice spans from the top vertical edge to the lower-right diagonal edge and is labeled 'Others (10%)'.
The slice spans from the upper-left diagonal edge to the lower-left diagonal edge and is labeled 'Xiaomi (20%)'.
The slice spans from the lower-right diagonal edge to the lower-left diagonal edge and is labeled 'Apple (15%)'.
Title text reads 'Smartphone Market Share in Europe'.

public_definitions: Use the Europe smartphone market share dashboard to identify the brand for market-leader follow-up.
Select Samsung as the current market leader
